english.title: Holder of aerial application certificate fail to make aerial application manual available to operating staff
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of an aerial application certificate under article 91(2) of the Air Navigation Order 2016, failed to make its aerial application manual available to every member of the operating staff
